author: MrWonderful32
quote:
Not what I expected I would be typing from a Nintendo Game... but this has to the the one of the worst Mario Kart games I ever played, the open world mode is just boring and unnecessary, all the races feel the same, Mario Kart World is relying too much on Gimmicks to trying and save is gameplay, but after the gimmicks wear off you're left with a very bland racing game with no substance, you can even say the basic gameplay alone is worse than Mario Kart 8 Deluxe, yes the game is charming, but being charming does not make up for the bad gameplay, skip this one.
Unfortunately it pains me to say but... IT'S NOT WORTH YOUR TIME.

author: MrWonderful32
quote: Pretty dissapointing, much of the charm of the original is gone and replaced with the most generic background assests I ever seen, the cutscenes are updated in so ways and in some other ways not so much they still feel outdated regardless of "Remake" name attached to it, gameplay was changed a bit and not for the good, the dragoons are pretty bouncy and that becomes very annoying when trying to aim, overall just a mediocre remake.

author: MrWonderful32
quote: I just finished the game, and I can say its the best game I ever played in years,  its certainty the most unique game this generation and kojima's best game to date, the world Is vast and beautiful,  the gameplay is unique it even makes walking and running fun by adding a balance mechanic which in itself is a Sort of mini game, definitely not  a game for everyone, it takes time to learn the mechanics, it's not a game you can just pick up and play, it takes time and dedication to learn the mechanics, this game requires patience and it's not for the weak, the story is **** of the most thought out and compelling story since The last of us, the soundtrack is orgasmic and the voice acting is solid,  the cast members all work in tandem beautifully... they actually complement eachother  it's a heck of a cast, you never seen so much talent in a video game ever, the visual effects and camera work is that of a AAA Hollywood movie, and the graphics are probably the best I've seen this generation, its the most photo realistic game I ever seen, this game is a Slam Dunk and it's a musty play that shouldn't be missed by anyone.

author: MrWonderful32
quote: In my 20 plus years of gaming I never seen such an overhyped and overrated game such as Astral Chain, the initial first hour of the game is so slow pace that almost made me stop playing, the framerate is God awful, theres framepacing issues all over the place,  the pacing of the game has no direction as it seems to be fluffed up with meaningless busy work,  the graphics are okay but the whole "Cell shaded " look is played out already and it's mostly used to Hide the switch's shortcomings, the whole Cell shaded look is pretty outdated by today's standards, ....yes it was great on zelda botw but now its just redundant and getting old, in conclusion...Astral Chain is just not worth the asking price as it plays more like a budget tittle than its AAA price suggests.

author: MrWonderful32
quote: I've never felt like a god of war game could get to this level, I was enamored by everything that it immersed me into its world so perfectly , I couldn't stop thinking about the game ever after I finished it, of course I got the game a few days earlier than most and the beautiful lush environment with life like textures, characters design, epic bosses are nothing short of outstanding, I've never seen a game that game the player the freedom to customize your weapons and stats to accommodate to your style of gameplay, whether you like slow for fast gameplay this game gives you an option to accommodate both,  the story was masterfully done all in a single shot no breaks from immersion, the gameplay is satisfying and fluid, this is a game I will remember be even 20 years from now, its a game for the ages and quite possibly the best game of this genre, this is the pinnacle of gaming and it should be played by everyone whom call ****.

author: MrWonderful32
quote: This game was literally built for children,  it was so easy to beat, you always have the advantage with cap on, allowing you to control other AI was a great idea with such bad execution, new donk city was far the worst 3D rendition of a metropolitan city I've seen in the past recent years,  the human AI character models look like human characters models from back in 2002, and I just can't get off how bad the anti-alliasing **** just too distracting and it disconnects the player from feeling immersed,  gameplay wise this game offers nothing new, its not trying to reinvent the wheel,  the Cap mechanic was good on paper but giving you the control of almost all AI gives the player almost no challenge.... plus there's no lives in this game, the player gets no punishment for making mistakes making this game just too easy,  if you're 10 yrs old this a great game for you,  if you're a teen or adult this game is way too easy for you.... you might as well go play captain toads adventure at least that game has puzzles which gives you a bit more of a challenge.

author: MrWonderful32
quote: Having put about 30 hours into the game I have to say this game is massively overrated, On my second run I found out you could skip all the way to the end in about 40 to 50 mns without any consequences,  I find this to be a big flaw in the game,  also at various points I found the game to be totally unplayable since frame-rates drop so bad the game stops to a halt, big open world for a zelda game but once you get to area you saw from a distance the textures where plain and boring, most of the open world is empty or you find very little to do, I find it very hard to believe this game even got a 98 by critics in the first place.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
